glossary.definition: A folder with a SKILL.md (YAML frontmatter with name and description) and optional files, exposed over MCP resources at skill://<skill-path>/<file>. The last segment of the skill path must equal the frontmatter name.
The resources array of a skill entry: every file exactly once (including SKILL.md) with its URI, SHA-256 digest and byte size. A host reads only URIs that are in it.

The sha256:<64 hex> digest and byte size in the manifest. A host checks both on every file it fetches and does not use a file that fails. A digest match is not a trust boundary: the digests are unsigned and come from the same server.
A host parses the fetched SKILL.md frontmatter and compares it field by field with the entry; any difference means the skill is not loaded. This lab uses the SDK's own parser for it.
An approval is bound to the resources set (every URI and digest). A changed set revokes it, and returning to the old set does not bring it back.
A frontmatter field asking for tool permissions. For a skill that came over MCP it is ignored unless the user explicitly approves that grant; hooks are ignored or gated the same way.
Names are labels, not identifiers. Two skills can share a name (one server or two); a host disambiguates them and does not let one silently replace the other.
An entry with resources: "dynamic". Its files cannot be pinned by digest, so a host may decline it and cannot bind an approval to it.
Skill text is untrusted model input. A host tags it with the server it came from and never runs a script from it without a per-skill approval. Nothing in this lab ever executes.
A skill is identified by the host's label for the server plus its URI. A read of another server's resource needs explicit per-call approval naming both servers.

sources.title: ext-skills specification (skills.mdx)
sources.use: Wire format and host requirements; read through a page summariser, not verbatim

stories.title: Digest mismatch
stories.say: The file is rejected (digest-mismatch); nothing from it reaches the model.

stories.title: Size mismatch
stories.say: The file is rejected (size-mismatch).

stories.title: Frontmatter differs from the entry
stories.say: The skill is not loaded (frontmatter-mismatch).

stories.title: Manifest swapped after approval
stories.say: The approval is revoked (approval-revoked); the skill needs a fresh approval.

stories.title: allowed-tools and hooks smuggled in frontmatter
stories.say: The skill loads, but no tool grant and no hook is honoured (allowed-tools-ignored, hooks-ignored).

stories.title: Same name from two skill paths and two servers
stories.say: All copies stay registered under distinct keys with disambiguated labels, and a collision is reported (name-collision).

stories.title: Dynamic skill
stories.say: Declined by default (dynamic-declined); if a host loads it anyway, approval cannot be content-bound (dynamic-not-bindable).

stories.title: Manifest URI outside the skill root (../ path traversal)
stories.say: The skill is refused (uri-outside-root); no request is made for the escaping URI.

stories.title: Manifest URI outside the skill root (absolute path)
stories.say: The skill is refused (uri-outside-root); no request is made for the escaping URI.

stories.title: Manifest URI outside the skill root (other scheme)
stories.say: The skill is refused (uri-outside-root); no request is made for the escaping URI.

stories.title: Manifest URI outside the skill root (percent-encoded ../)
stories.say: The skill is refused (uri-outside-root); no request is made for the escaping URI.

stories.title: Manifest URI outside the skill root (percent-encoded backslash (%5C))
stories.say: The skill is refused (uri-outside-root); no request is made for the escaping URI.

stories.title: More than 512 files
stories.say: Declined at listing time (limit-files), before any file is read.

stories.title: Over 16 MiB
stories.say: Declined at listing time (limit-bytes), before any file is read.

stories.title: Prompt injection in SKILL.md and a script
stories.say: Content is tagged untrusted with its origin; the script run is denied (script-exec-denied); nothing is executed. Marker scan is informational.

stories.title: Skill missing from the listing, served by skills/get
stories.say: The host can get the unlisted skill. Flagging it as unlisted (unlisted-skill) and applying the same checks and approvals is lab policy.

stories.title: Skill points at another server's resource
stories.say: The cross-server read is denied without approval (cross-server-denied); with approval naming both servers it is allowed.

stories.title: Read of a file the manifest does not list
stories.say: The read is refused before any request (unlisted-file-read).

stories.title: Skill path does not end with the frontmatter name
stories.say: The skill is refused (name-path-mismatch).

stories.title: Hidden line in a block-scalar description
stories.say: The skill is not loaded (frontmatter-mismatch): the description the user approved differs from what SKILL.md says.

stories.title: Manifest that omits SKILL.md
stories.say: The skill is refused (manifest-missing-skill-md); nothing is read.

stories.title: A SKILL.md that is only a supporting file
stories.say: The file is data (nested-skill): its frontmatter is not read or granted, and activating it without its own consent is denied (nested-activation-denied).

stories.title: Skills extension declared without the resources capability
stories.say: The host does not call any skills method on that server (resources-capability-missing).
